hero.title: Shopify stores that look great and sell more
hero.text: MFS Developer builds fast, mobile-friendly Shopify stores for growing brands. From setup to custom features, we handle the technical work so you can focus on selling.

about.title: About MFS Developer
about.text: We are a Shopify development team that works directly with store owners. No middlemen, clear pricing, and code that is clean and easy to maintain. Whether you are launching your first store or fixing an existing one, we build it the right way.
points: Clear scope, price and timeline before we start

services.description: Custom sections and layouts built in Liquid to match your brand exactly.

services.title: Speed optimization

services.title: Store migration

services.title: Support and fixes
